name: kiln-build-prd
description: Full spec-first build pipeline as a resumable wheel workflow: config -> precedent -> specify -> plan -> tasks -> gate -> implement (team) -> test -> smoke -> audit (parallel panel team) -> synthesize -> fix-blocking -> PR -> retro -> classify -> summary. Checkpoints are branch+approval pairs gated on .kiln/config.json review_checkpoints (or upstream blocking severity). Reconciled to the real wheel runtime: concrete models (no model_tier), defensive exit-0 (no on_failure), native team-create/teammate/team-wait/team-delete (no type:team), branch routing.

steps.command: PRD_SLUG=$(cat .wheel/inputs/prd-slug.txt 2>/dev/null); PRD_PATH="docs/features/${PRD_SLUG}/PRD.md"; if [ ! -f "$PRD_PATH" ]; then echo "ERROR: PRD not found at $PRD_PATH" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "$PRD_PATH" > .wheel/outputs/prd-path.txt; cat "$PRD_PATH"

STD=$(jq -r '.standards // ".kiln/standards.md"' .wheel/outputs/kiln-config.json 2>/dev/null || echo '.kiln/standards.md'); cat "$STD" 2>/dev/null || echo '## Coding Standards\n\n_No standards file found — using defaults._'

RUN_ID=$(uuidgen | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || date +%s); PRD_SLUG=$(cat .wheel/inputs/prd-slug.txt 2>/dev/null); BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); mkdir -p ".kiln/runs/${RUN_ID}/agent-notes"; printf '{"run_id":"%s","prd":"docs/features/%s/PRD.md","phase":"specify","branch":"%s","pr":null,"decisions":[],"escalations":[],"cursor":"init-run-manifest","cost":{"total_usd":0,"input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":0,"by_model":{}}}' "$RUN_ID" "$PRD_SLUG" "$BRANCH" > ".kiln/runs/${RUN_ID}/manifest.json"; echo "$RUN_ID" > .wheel/outputs/run-id.txt; cat ".kiln/runs/${RUN_ID}/manifest.json"

steps.instruction:
You are the specifier. Produce a complete spec.md for the PRD.

## Inputs
- PRD: read .wheel/outputs/prd-content.md
- Standards: read .wheel/outputs/standards-block.md — FOLLOW THESE for every interface you define.
- Precedent: read .wheel/outputs/precedent-block.md — AVOID the listed past mistakes.

## Output
Get the prd-slug from .wheel/inputs/prd-slug.txt. Write specs/<slug>/spec.md with:
- ## User Stories (one per actor, labeled US-1, US-2, ...)
- ## Functional Requirements (FR-001, FR-002, ...)
- ## Non-Functional Requirements (NFR-001, ...)
- ## Acceptance Criteria (one scenario per FR)
- ## Open Questions

Emit verdict JSON: {"agent":"specifier","verdict":"pass","severity":"pass","spec_path":"specs/<slug>/spec.md","fr_count":N,"open_questions":[]}. Set severity=blocking only if you cannot produce a coherent spec from the PRD.

steps.command: CKPTS=$(jq -r '.review_checkpoints // [] | join(",")' .wheel/outputs/kiln-config.json 2>/dev/null); SEV=$(jq -r '.severity // "pass"' .wheel/outputs/specify-verdict.json 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CKPTS" | grep -q 'post-spec' || [ "$SEV" = 'blocking' ]; then echo 'pause'; exit 1; else echo 'skip'; exit 0; fi

steps.message: Post-spec checkpoint: review specs/<slug>/spec.md (FRs, acceptance criteria, open questions). Approve to continue to planning, or stop the workflow to revise.

steps.instruction:
You are the planner. Produce plan.md and contracts/interfaces.md.

## Inputs
- Spec: read the spec.md path from .wheel/outputs/specify-verdict.json
- Standards: read .wheel/outputs/standards-block.md — ALL interface names + signatures MUST follow the naming rules; functions declare <=2 params or an options object.
- Precedent: read .wheel/outputs/precedent-block.md

## Output
1. specs/<slug>/plan.md — technical approach, phases, file list.
2. specs/<slug>/contracts/interfaces.md — EVERY exported function: name, params, return type, sync/async, and which FR it satisfies. This is the single source of truth implementers match exactly.

Emit verdict JSON: {"agent":"planner","verdict":"pass","plan_path":"...","contracts_path":"...","interface_count":N}

You are the task planner. Produce specs/<slug>/tasks.md from the spec and plan.

## Inputs
- Spec verdict: .wheel/outputs/specify-verdict.json
- Plan verdict: .wheel/outputs/plan-verdict.json

## Output
specs/<slug>/tasks.md with ordered, dependency-aware tasks GROUPED UNDER USER STORIES. Use `### US-<n> <title>` headings (the dispatch step splits on these), with `- [ ] <task>` lines under each. Each task references the FR it implements and the interface(s) it touches, and is completable in one session without breaking the build.

Emit verdict JSON: {"agent":"task-planner","verdict":"pass","tasks_path":"...","task_count":N,"story_count":N}

steps.command: SLUG=$(cat .wheel/inputs/prd-slug.txt 2>/dev/null); ERR=''; for f in spec.md plan.md tasks.md contracts/interfaces.md; do [ -f "specs/${SLUG}/$f" ] || ERR="$ERR $f missing;"; done; if [ -n "$ERR" ]; then echo "GATE FAIL:$ERR" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo '{"gate":"pass"}'

SLUG=$(cat .wheel/inputs/prd-slug.txt 2>/dev/null); TASKS="specs/${SLUG}/tasks.md"; STORIES=$(grep -E '^### US-' "$TASKS" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^### //' | jq -R . | jq -s . 2>/dev/null || echo '[]'); COUNT=$(echo "$STORIES" | jq 'length' 2>/dev/null || echo 0); printf '{"stories":%s,"count":%s,"tasks_path":"%s"}' "$STORIES" "$COUNT" "$TASKS" > .wheel/inputs/implement-dispatch.json; echo "Dispatch: $COUNT user stories to the implement team"; cat .wheel/inputs/implement-dispatch.json

assign.note: Implement every user story in specs/<slug>/tasks.md in order. (v1: single slot owns all stories; bounded static team — additional implementer slots can be added when worktree isolation lands.)

steps.command: GATE=$(jq -r '.coverage_gate // 80' .kiln/test-strategy.json 2>/dev/null || echo 80); CMD=$(jq -r '.test // "npm test"' .kiln/test-strategy.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'npm test'); eval "$CMD" > .wheel/outputs/test-output.log 2>&1; EXIT=$?; printf '{"exit":%s,"coverage_gate":%s,"log":".wheel/outputs/test-output.log"}' "$EXIT" "$GATE"

steps.instruction:
You are the smoke reviewer. Verify the implementation works at runtime.

## Inputs
- .kiln/test-strategy.json — smoke.start / smoke.ready / smoke.probe / smoke.teardown, and design_verify.
- .wheel/outputs/test-results.json; .wheel/inputs/prd-slug.txt.

## Steps
1. Start the app per smoke.start; wait for smoke.ready; run smoke.probe; stop per smoke.teardown.
2. If design_verify is true and design/<slug>/mockup.{png,jpg,html} exists, screenshot the running app and estimate a 0-100 fidelity match.
3. Write specs/<slug>/smoke-report.md (use scaffold/smoke-report-template.md shape) and COPY it to .wheel/outputs/smoke-report.md (build-summary reads from there).

If the app cannot start or there is nothing runnable yet, do NOT error: write a report noting that and emit verdict severity=warn.

Emit .wheel/outputs/smoke-verdict.json: {"agent":"smoke-reviewer","verdict":"pass|fail","severity":"pass|warn|blocking","findings":[],"fidelity_score":null,"report_path":"specs/<slug>/smoke-report.md"}

steps.command: CKPTS=$(jq -r '.review_checkpoints // [] | join(",")' .wheel/outputs/kiln-config.json 2>/dev/null); SEV=$(jq -r '.severity // "pass"' .wheel/outputs/smoke-verdict.json 2>/dev/null); IMPL=$(jq -r '.verdict // "pass"' .wheel/outputs/implement-worker-verdict.json 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CKPTS" | grep -q 'post-implement' || [ "$SEV" = 'blocking' ] || [ "$IMPL" = 'blocked' ]; then echo 'pause'; exit 1; else echo 'skip'; exit 0; fi

steps.message: Post-implement checkpoint: review the implementation + smoke report. Approve to continue to audit, or stop to address blockers.

steps.instruction:
You are the audit synthesizer. Merge the per-role audit verdicts into one result.

## Inputs (the 3 panel members each wrote a role-specific verdict file)
- .wheel/outputs/audit-prd-auditor-verdict.json
- .wheel/outputs/audit-spec-enforcer-verdict.json
- .wheel/outputs/audit-quality-judge-verdict.json
Each is {role, severity, compliance_pct, findings[]}. Any that is missing/unreadable: treat as a warn with no findings (do not error). (.wheel/outputs/audit-results/ holds wheel's collected context/assignment blobs — NOT the verdicts; read the three files above directly.)

## Task
1. Read the three role verdict files.
2. Overall severity: blocking if ANY finding is blocking; else warn if any warn; else pass.
3. Deduplicate findings by file+fr.
4. compliance_pct: take the prd-auditor's value (or the min across roles that report one).
5. Write .wheel/outputs/audit-verdict.json: {"compliance_pct":N,"severity":"pass|warn|blocking","findings":[{"severity","fr","file","description"}],"blockers_path":null}.
6. If severity=blocking, write the blocking findings to .wheel/outputs/blocking-findings.json (an array); else write [].

You are the blocking-fix implementer. Resolve audit findings that block the PR. Fix INLINE — do NOT spawn sub-agents or call kiln-fix.

## Inputs
- .wheel/outputs/blocking-findings.json — blocking findings (may be []).
- .wheel/outputs/audit-verdict.json; specs/<slug>/spec.md; specs/<slug>/contracts/interfaces.md.

## Task
1. If blocking-findings.json is empty or absent: emit {"fixed":0,"skipped":true} and stop.
2. For each blocking finding: read the implicated file, understand the FR it violates, fix the implementation to satisfy the FR without breaking other contracts.
3. Re-run the test suite to confirm no regression.
4. Any finding you cannot fix: mark status=escalate (it surfaces as priority 1 in kiln-next).
5. Emit .wheel/outputs/fix-blocking-verdict.json: {"fixed":N,"remaining":N,"findings":[{"fr","file","fix_summary","status":"fixed|escalate"}]}

steps.command: CKPTS=$(jq -r '.review_checkpoints // [] | join(",")' .wheel/outputs/kiln-config.json 2>/dev/null); AUTO=$(jq -r '.auto_pr // false' .wheel/outputs/kiln-config.json 2>/dev/null); SEV=$(jq -r '.severity // "pass"' .wheel/outputs/audit-verdict.json 2>/dev/null); if [ "$AUTO" = 'true' ]; then echo 'skip(auto_pr)'; exit 0; elif echo "$CKPTS" | grep -q 'pre-pr' || [ "$SEV" = 'blocking' ]; then echo 'pause'; exit 1; else echo 'skip'; exit 0; fi

steps.message: Pre-PR checkpoint: review the audit verdict + fix-blocking results. Approve to open the PR, or stop to address findings.

steps.command:
SLUG=$(cat .wheel/inputs/prd-slug.txt 2>/dev/null); AUDIT=$(jq -r '.compliance_pct // "?"' .wheel/outputs/audit-verdict.json 2>/dev/null); BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); STYLE=$(jq -r '.branching.style // "github-flow"' .wheel/outputs/kiln-config.json 2>/dev/null); if [ "$STYLE" = 'gitflow' ]; then BASE=$(jq -r '.branching.integration_branch // "dev"' .wheel/outputs/kiln-config.json 2>/dev/null); else BASE='main'; fi; git push -u origin "$BRANCH" 2>&1 || echo 'push failed (continuing)'; PR_URL=$(gh pr create --base "$BASE" --title "feat($SLUG): build-prd pipeline" --body "PRD: docs/features/${SLUG}/PRD.md

Audit compliance: ${AUDIT}%

Generated by kiln-build-prd." --label 'build-prd' 2>&1 || echo 'PR-CREATE-FAILED'); printf '{"pr_url":"%s","base":"%s"}' "$PR_URL" "$BASE"

CKPTS=$(jq -r '.review_checkpoints // [] | join(",")' .wheel/outputs/kiln-config.json 2>/dev/null); AUTO=$(jq -r '.auto_merge // false' .wheel/outputs/kiln-config.json 2>/dev/null); if [ "$AUTO" = 'true' ]; then echo 'skip(auto_merge)'; exit 0; elif echo "$CKPTS" | grep -q 'pre-merge'; then echo 'pause'; exit 1; else echo 'skip'; exit 0; fi

steps.message: Pre-merge checkpoint: the PR is open. Approve to finish the run (retro + summary), or stop to review the PR before merge.

steps.instruction:
You are the retrospective collector. Gather friction from this build and write it to the ledger.

## Inputs
- run-id from .wheel/outputs/run-id.txt; agent-notes from .kiln/runs/<run-id>/agent-notes/*.md; the verdict files (specify, plan, tasks, implement, audit, smoke).

## Output
1. Write .kiln/runs/<run-id>/retro.md using scaffold/retro-template.md (what went well / what slowed us down / improvement proposals / insight_score 1-5).
2. For each concrete improvement proposal (actionable, with a target file/prompt), write a proposal stub to .kiln/ledger/proposals/<run-id>-<n>.json: {id, target, patch, risk:null, blast_radius, rationale, ledger_refs:[]}.
3. For each mistake-class friction (a wrong assumption / hallucination / incorrect output by the build), write the mistake to the ledger INLINE — do NOT invoke another workflow from inside this one. For each: generate id `<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>`, write .kiln/mistakes/<id>.md (frontmatter: id, source: retro, tags: one mistake/* + one topic/* + one stack tag; body: ## Summary / ## Wrong assumption / ## Correction) AND .kiln/ledger/<id>.json ({id, kind:"mistake", summary, detail:"<assumption> → <correction>", blast_radius, tags, source_path, ts}). The next shelf-sync's ledger-mirror backfills these to Obsidian.
4. Emit {"agent":"retrospective","ledger_entries":N,"proposals":N,"retro_path":"...","insight_score":N}.

You are the risk classifier. Classify each retro improvement proposal from this run as low or high risk.

## Inputs
- .wheel/outputs/retro-verdict.json; the proposal stubs .kiln/ledger/proposals/<run-id>-*.json written by collect-retro.

## Rules
- LOW: single-file SKILL.md/template/.kiln config edit, no hook/gate/workflow/cross-plugin change, local blast_radius.
- HIGH: touches hooks/*.sh, gates, workflows/*.json, cross-plugin contracts, or blast_radius cross-plugin. Uncertain -> HIGH.

For each proposal, fill the FULL schema in .kiln/ledger/proposals/<id>.json: {id, target, patch, risk:"low"|"high", blast_radius, rationale, ledger_refs[]}. Emit {"agent":"risk-classifier","low_count":N,"high_count":N,"proposal_paths":[]}.

steps.command: THR=$(jq -r '.pi_apply_threshold // "none"' .wheel/outputs/kiln-config.json 2>/dev/null); if [ "$THR" = 'none' ]; then echo '{"applied":0,"skipped":"threshold=none"}'; exit 0; fi; LOW=$(jq -r '.low_count // 0' .wheel/outputs/classify-verdict.json 2>/dev/null || echo 0); printf '{"applied":0,"pending":%s,"threshold":"%s"}' "$LOW" "$THR"

RID=$(cat .wheel/outputs/run-id.txt 2>/dev/null); PR=$(jq -r '.pr_url // null' .wheel/outputs/pr-result.json 2>/dev/null); M=".kiln/runs/${RID}/manifest.json"; if [ -n "$RID" ] && [ -f "$M" ]; then jq --arg pr "$PR" '.phase="done" | .pr=$pr | .cursor="update-run-manifest"' "$M" > /tmp/m.$$.json 2>/dev/null && mv /tmp/m.$$.json "$M"; fi; cp "$M" .wheel/outputs/run-manifest-final.json 2>/dev/null; echo 'manifest updated to done'

steps.instruction: You are the build summary agent (the run's final step — render a summary even if upstream steps failed). Read .wheel/outputs/prd-content.md, audit-verdict.json, test-results.json, smoke-report.md, pr-result.json, run-manifest-final.json, and `git diff --stat HEAD~1`. Render the canonical 5-table markdown summary (Overview with Tokens+Cost rows / What Changed / What to Test / Findings [omit if none] / Links) exactly as agents/build-summary.md specifies. Write it to .kiln/runs/<run-id>/summary.md AND print the full summary as your output — the human reads it directly.
